profile.headline: Business Systems Analyst III at Mitsubishi Chemical America - Polyester Film Division
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the financial services and manufacturing industries. Skilled in C# software development, SQL Server database design and modification, SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), as well as programmatic interaction with a wide variety of database platforms and other data sources.

company.name: Mitsubishi Chemical America - Polyester Film Division

positions.title: Business System Analyst
positions.description:
• Lead development and enhancement of multiple ASP.NET and JavaScript web applications supporting core manufacturing and business processes.
• Architect and implement Microsoft SQL Server schemas, tables, and stored procedures to support new and evolving application functionality.
• Design and deploy Azure-hosted REST APIs using .NET Core, enabling scalable integrations across internal systems.
• Build and deploy Azure SQL databases, including data modeling and environment configuration.
• Develop automated applications that trigger business notifications based on complex rule sets.
• Create applications that insert and update SAP data, supporting enterprise system integration.
• Maintain and enhance systems responsible for product and pallet label printing, ensuring operational accuracy and continuity.

company.name: Mitsubishi Chemical America – Polyester Film Division

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed multiple .NET Core REST APIs supporting the company’s primary website and mobile applications (Android and iOS via Xamarin).
• Enhanced and maintained a mission-critical ASP.NET web application with a web service backend used to process and track bankruptcy cases.
• Designed service-oriented architectures to decouple web and desktop applications from underlying databases.
• Led a complex data migration from Sybase to Microsoft SQL Server, while maintaining dual-read/write compatibility during the legacy system lifecycle.
• Modified and optimized tables, stored procedures, and custom functions across SQL Server and Sybase to resolve issues and enable new features.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Designing, building, and maintaining web and windows applications to improve process performance, as well as designing, building, and maintaining databases across multiple database platforms.

positions.title: Programming Analyst
positions.description:
• Designed and built ASP.NET web applications and WinForms solutions supporting federal student loan and grant processing.
• Architected and maintained SQL Server databases, including backup strategies, maintenance plans, and performance tuning.
• Developed and maintained SSRS reports for both internal stakeholders and external clients.
• Continuously enhanced systems to remain compliant with frequently changing government regulations.
• Migrated and secured data from governmental sources into SQL databases, transforming sensitive data into usable, compliant reporting outputs.
